content.text: Jeevan Umang is a **participating whole-life plan** that provides an ongoing (lifelong) survival income after the premium paying term. It combines life insurance protection with a recurring income stream — making it attractive for retirement planning. The plan also accrues bonuses and may include final additional bonuses where applicable.

sections.title: How the LIC Jeevan Umang Calculator Works (Formulas Explained)

content.text:
H3 — Premium calculation

  • Base annual premium = lookup from LIC rate table depending on Age, BSA and PPT.
  • Mode conversion uses modal loading factors:
    • Half-yearly = Yearly × 0.5098
    • Quarterly = Yearly × 0.2575
    • Monthly = Yearly × 0.0879

H3 — Guaranteed Additions (GAs)

GAs are paid during the Premium Paying Term at a fixed rate per ₹1,000 of BSA. Total GAs = Annual GA × PPT.

H3 — Survival income (post-PPT)

Regular income is a fixed percentage of BSA paid annually after PPT (e.g., 8% of BSA). Unwithdrawn income may accumulate at a guaranteed rate.

H3 — Maturity & death benefits

The main benefit is the lifetime income. Death benefit is typically Sum Assured on Death plus bonuses, or 105% of total premiums paid.

H3 — Age / gender

Younger entrants pay lower premiums.

H3 — Basic Sum Assured (BSA)

The core coverage amount; survival income and GAs are derived from BSA.

H3 — Premium Paying Term (PPT)

Shorter PPT means higher annual premium but faster income start.

H3 — Payment Mode

Yearly is cheapest. Monthly is convenient but costlier.

H3 — Riders

Optional covers add to the premium but not the core benefits.

H3 — Example 1 — Young saver (age 30, BSA ₹10L, PPT 12)

Input: Age 30, BSA 10,00,000, PPT 12, Yearly mode. Outputs: Annual premium ≈ ₹95,000; Post-PPT survival income = 8% × BSA = ₹80,000/yr (paid for life); Estimated IRR ~5–6%.

H3 — Example 2 — Pre-retiree (age 50, BSA ₹15L, PPT 8)

Input: Age 50, BSA 15,00,000, PPT 8. Outputs: Annual premium ≈ ₹2,15,000; Survival income post-PPT = ₹1,20,000/yr.

H3 — Example 3 — High SA (age 35, BSA ₹1 Cr, PPT 10)

Illustrates high sum assured rebate logic. Calculator applies rebate automatically.

• Paid-up value: If premiums stop after 2+ years, policy becomes paid-up with reduced SA.
  • Surrender value: Available after 2 yrs. Calculator estimates GSV or SSV.
  • Loan: You can take a loan up to a percentage of SSV.

items.q: What is the Jeevan Umang calculator and is it free?
items.a: The Jeevan Umang calculator is a free online tool to estimate premiums, survival income and related values for LIC Plan 945. It provides quick, illustrative figures — not a binding LIC quote.

items.q: How do I calculate Jeevan Umang premium?
items.a: Enter your age, BSA, PPT and mode into the calculator. The tool uses LIC rate tables and modal factors to compute yearly and mode premiums.

items.q: What is the survival income under Jeevan Umang?
items.a: Survival income is a yearly payment after PPT — typically a fixed percentage of Basic Sum Assured (e.g., 8%).

items.q: Does the calculator include riders and GST?
items.a: Yes — toggle riders to see additional rider premiums. The calculator also shows GST in the premium breakdown.
Results are estimates. For a binding quote, contact LIC. The accuracy depends on input assumptions.

items.q: Can NRIs use the Jeevan Umang calculator?
items.a: Yes, for planning, but eligibility depends on LIC and FEMA rules.

items.q: When can I take a loan against Jeevan Umang?
items.a: Typically after 2 full years when the policy has a surrender value.
Generally tax-favored under Section 10(10D), but consult a tax advisor.
If premiums stop after 2+ years, the policy continues with a reduced Sum Assured.

items.q: How to compare Jeevan Umang with Jeevan Utsav or Jeevan Labh?
items.a: Use the calculator to compare illustrations for the same BSA to see which fits your goals.
